scope: One fixed GI+SA configuration, five development days, five seeds per day. Replications are within-day seed variation, not 25 independent input days.

settings.constructor: original greedy insertion freshly called each dispatch
settings.neighbourhood: swap two distinct parcel positions, fixed membership

aggregation.across_days_final_score: Not selected; no pooled or mean overall Score B is reported.
aggregation.within_day: Arithmetic mean, range, and sample standard deviation across seeds 0–4.
aggregation.paired_outcome_counts: Descriptive counts only; each input day is repeated five times.

runtime_note: Observed command durations on this machine; not a controlled speed comparison with earlier policies.
interpretation: SA has a small, inconsistent Score B effect relative to original insertion on these five development days.
Day 005 has seed variation; reporting only its best seed would conceal a seed that loses to original insertion.
Every returned route dominates its fresh greedy seed by route credit then distance. Changed returns and later snapshots can still reduce full-day Score B, as on day 003.
Fixed membership limits the search to parcel order; it cannot directly repair which parcels or vehicles were selected.
All paired Score B winners remain unchanged at outside-window credits 0.25 and 0.75.
No further tuning or evaluation on days 006–020 was performed.
